reviews.text:
For some reason, whenever I try to use the “Ad Unlock” option for my widgets, I get a message saying “Failed to load AD,” followed by the options to try again later or purchase iScreen Premium.

At first, I assumed this was just a temporary issue, but I’ve been trying again repeatedly over the past several days and it still doesn’t work. I’ve checked multiple times, but the same error keeps appearing every time.

Could you please look into this and fix the issue? It’s extremely frustrating to have a feature that is supposed to work through watching an ad be completely unusable.

reviews.text: 当时看评论里说这个软件怎么样怎么样好，但是下载过后才发现，这个软件差到极点！刚刚下载时打开还是很正常的，就是有一点卡而已，然后就退出了。结果第二次打开时发现一直卡在一个白色屏幕上，动也动不了，退也退不了，之后几次一直是这样。我是真没话说了……总之，千万千万不要下载这个软件，否则很可能会抓狂！

reviews.text: 我之前用的是另外一个软件 因为换手机版本不能用了才下载的这个软件 带今天我刚有了这个软件6天 我已经不知道看了多少个广告了 也不知道给我闪退出去多少次了 刚才我想添加一个新组件 在他这个软件里是动态的到了桌面就不动了 我还试了好几个都是不动的 还有闪退的问题 一直以为是我手机的问题 我就用了其他软件根本没有什么卡顿闪退的问题 我真没招了

reviews.title: so frustrating
reviews.text: it has some really good content just had to delete it in the end i got so frustrated with the hundreds of long ads and CONSTANT clicking off.  you really need to make it less frustrating for people
